text: 10月22日，宁德时代在港交所公告称，于当日斥资近5亿元人民币回购227.1万股A股，每股回购价格为218.79-221.5元人民币，拟用于注销。
text_en: On October 22, CATL announced on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange that on that day it spent nearly RMB 500 million to repurchase 2.271 million A-shares at a repurchase price of RMB 218.79-221.5 per share, to be used for cancellation.
